nodes.description: Public state variable baseAddr holding the hard-coded address 0x500Df47E1dF0ef06039218dCF0960253D89D6658 used as the target token contract.
State variable bcontract of interface type TokenERC20, initialized from baseAddr and used as the external call target.
Public state variable distributedAmount (initialized to 2001200) tracking how many tokens the airdrop has distributed.
Public sendOutToken(address[] addrs) function that loops over the supplied addresses and performs the airdrop; it has no access control and no reentrancy guard.
Payable fallback function that unconditionally reverts, rejecting all plain ether transfers.
msg.sender, the caller-supplied address used as the _from argument of the external transferFrom call.
Parameter addrs: caller-supplied dynamic array of recipient addresses iterated over in the airdrop loop.
Local loop counter i controlling the iteration over the addrs array.
External call bcontract.transferFrom(msg.sender, addrs[i], 100 * 10**18) executed inside the loop with unbounded loop length and before any bookkeeping update.
Unchecked arithmetic update distributedAmount += 100 executed after the external token transfer (Solidity 0.5.x has no overflow protection).
External calls bcontract.balanceOf(addrs[i]) (twice) plus addrs[i].balance used as airdrop eligibility checks and as event arguments.

edges.reason: baseAddr is used as the constructor argument to instantiate the TokenERC20 interface instance bcontract.
msg.sender is passed directly as the _from argument of the external transferFrom call.
Elements of the addrs parameter are passed as the _to argument of transferFrom inside the loop.
The length of the addrs parameter determines the loop iteration count and therefore how many times distributedAmount is incremented by 100 without overflow checks.
Elements of addrs are passed to bcontract.balanceOf and to the addrs[i].balance eligibility check.
The loop counter i indexes addrs[i] used as the recipient of the external transferFrom call.
bcontract is the storage reference on which the external transferFrom call is invoked.
bcontract is the storage reference on which the external balanceOf calls are invoked.
sendOutToken controls execution of the external transferFrom call inside the else branch of the loop.
sendOutToken controls execution of the distributedAmount += 100 state update that follows the transfer.
sendOutToken controls execution of the balanceOf checks and the cannotAirdrop event emission.

The external token transfer to an attacker-controlled/loop-supplied address occurs before the distributedAmount state update, allowing reentrant re-entry of sendOutToken before accounting is finalized.
The unchecked increment mutates the distributedAmount state variable.
Any externally supplied msg.sender can invoke the unguarded sendOutToken function.

normalization_plan.reason: The addrs parameter is a non-core input local to sendOutToken; it should be absorbed into the enclosing core function node for graph normalization.
The loop counter i is a non-core local variable whose only role is to drive iteration inside the core function sendOutToken.
